summary.name: Gaoding
summary.one_liner: Gaoding (稿定设计) is an online design platform with templates for posters, resumes, PPTs, business cards, Logos and social media graphics, aimed at users without Photoshop skills.
use_cases: Making social media covers for Xiaohongshu or WeChat articles
Designing e-commerce product main images and detail pages
Creating posters, flyers and invitations without design skills
Designing resumes, business cards and logos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an online design tool with a large library of templates across categories such as e-commerce, WeChat and Xiaohongshu social media, print materials, PPT and H5 pages. It lists features including 3-second background removal (抠图), batch template application (批量套版), and AI-assisted design. It states that its template and material resources are licensed for commercial use. The page is largely a marketing and template-browsing page, so specific feature depth and pricing are not detailed.
notable: Large template library covering e-commerce, social media, print and PPT formats
3-second background removal and batch template application
AI-assisted design features including AI canvas and AI e-commerce tools
Licensed resources stated as usable for commercial purposes
caveats: Pricing and paid tiers are not stated on the page
Interface and content are primarily in Chinese
Feature details beyond the listed categories are limited
